sentences.text:
For the Informant: Mr. Rohit Agrawal
 -----
06/11.09.2024

The petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with the case registered under Sections 323, 341, 498A, 406, 420, 504, 506 & 34 IPC and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the husband of the complainant/informant.

3. It is jointly submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the complainant/informant that the mediation proceeding between both the parties has been successful as they have amicably settled their disputes.
The terms and conditions of the said settlement have been appended with the mediation report dated 06.09.2024 submitted by the Mediator, Jharkhand State Legal Services Authority (JHALSA), Ranchi.

entities.text: Jharkhand State Legal Services Authority (JHALSA), Ranchi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that as per the terms and conditions of the settlement, the petitioners are required to pay Rs.16 Lacs in total, out of which the first installment of Rs.4.5 Lacs has already been paid to the complainant/informant.
A Demand Draft of Rs.1 Lac has also been prepared by way of second installment and the same is being handed over to learned counsel for the complainant/informant in the Court itself.

5. Learned counsel for the complainant/informant accepts the said Demand Draft.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioner also submits that the petitioner will abide by the terms and conditions of the settlement appended with the mediation report dated 06.09.2024 and will make payment of the rest of the installments on the due dates.

7. Having heard learned counsel for the parties as well as considering that the petitioner and the complainant/informant have amicably settled their dispute at JHALSA, Ranchi, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.
Accordingly, the above named petitioner is directed to surrender before the concerned Court below within a period of three weeks.

If he surrenders before the Court below within the aforesaid period, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.20,000/- (twenty thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the C.J.M, Seraikella in connection with Ghamhariya P.S. Case No. 77/2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
Satish/- (RAJESH SHANKAR, J)
